$comment: Source of truth for the Scholarships hub. scripts/build_scholarships_index.py reads this to regenerate scholarships.html's card grid and sitemap.xml's scholarship-page entries — do not hand-edit scholarships.html's card list directly, edit this file instead and re-run the build script (or push, which triggers it automatically). New entries are added automatically by scripts/generate_scholarship_post.py, which only ever adds scholarships it can cite from an official source — human review happens via the GitHub PR it opens before anything is merged to main. Every entry here must have a matching scholarship-<slug>.html detail page.

scholarships.title: Chevening Scholarship 2027 (UK, Fully Funded Master's)
scholarships.summary: The UK government's flagship global scholarship funds a one-year taught master's degree at any UK university, covering tuition, a monthly stipend, airfare, and visa costs.
scholarships.meta_description: Chevening Scholarship 2027: fully funded UK master's degree for future leaders. Deadline 6 October 2026. Eligibility, benefits, and how to apply.

scholarships.title: Gates Cambridge Scholarship 2027/28 (UK, Fully Funded PhD & Master's)
scholarships.summary: A full-cost scholarship for outstanding applicants from outside the UK to pursue a full-time postgraduate degree at the University of Cambridge, covering tuition, maintenance, and more. Applications reopen in September 2026 for 2027/28 entry.
scholarships.meta_description: Gates Cambridge Scholarship 2027/28: fully funded PhD and master's study at Cambridge for non-UK citizens. Applications open September 2026, deadlines from 14 October 2026.
scholarships.funder: Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation / University of Cambridge

scholarships.title: DAAD Scholarship 2027 (Germany, Fully Funded Master's)
scholarships.summary: The DAAD Study Scholarship funds international graduates to pursue Master's degrees at German universities, covering monthly stipend, insurance, travel, and study allowance for 10-24 months starting October 2027.
scholarships.meta_description: DAAD Study Scholarship 2027: Fully funded Master's in Germany with €992/month stipend, insurance, travel allowance. Deadline Oct-Nov 2026. Open to all disciplines.

scholarships.title: AAUW International Fellowship 2027 (USA, STEM Master's & PhD for Women)
scholarships.summary: The AAUW International Fellowship supports women pursuing full-time STEM graduate degrees at accredited U.S. institutions, with awards of $20,000 (Master's) or $25,000 (PhD) for the 2027–2028 academic year.
scholarships.meta_description: AAUW International Fellowship 2027 offers $20,000-$25,000 for international women pursuing STEM Master's or PhD degrees in the USA. Deadline: September 17, 2026.

scholarships.title: Commonwealth Master's Scholarships 2027/28 (UK, Fully Funded)
scholarships.summary: Commonwealth Master's Scholarships fund one-year taught Master's degrees at UK universities for candidates from low- and middle-income Commonwealth countries, covering tuition, living costs, flights, and more.
scholarships.meta_description: Commonwealth Master's Scholarships 2027/28 offer fully funded one-year Master's study in the UK for Commonwealth citizens. Applications open September 8, deadline October 20, 2026.
scholarships.funder: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission (funded by UK Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office)

scholarships.title: Rhodes Scholarship 2027 (UK, Fully Funded Postgraduate at Oxford)
scholarships.summary: The Rhodes Scholarship is the world's oldest international postgraduate award, funding outstanding students from around the globe to undertake full-time study at the University of Oxford. Deadlines vary by constituency.
scholarships.meta_description: Rhodes Scholarship 2027 funds full postgraduate study at Oxford for exceptional leaders worldwide. Fully funded. Deadlines vary by region; U.S. closes October 7, 2026.
